toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses ('Voëls bou ...' and 'insekte vreet ...').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each side of 'en' has its own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Al hierdie diere kry iets by die boom wat hulle nodig het
toegepas.na: Al hierdie diere kry by die boom iets wat hulle nodig het
toegepas.rede_vinder: The relative clause should follow its antecedent 'iets' directly, or it reads as if 'wat' refers to the tree.
toegepas.fout: The relative clause 'wat hulle nodig het' sits directly after 'die boom', so it can be read as the tree being what they need.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Placing 'iets' right before its relative clause removes the ambiguity without changing who gets what from where.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.rede_keurder: Two clauses with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take the AWS 2017 comma; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Baie plante het diere nodig vir stuifmeel
toegepas.voor: nadat stuifmeel so by hulle aankom
toegepas.na: nadat stuifmeel so by hulle aangekom het
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'nadat' marks a completed earlier action and normally takes the perfect tense.
toegepas.fout: 'nadat' with a plain present verb; standard Afrikaans uses the perfect for the completed earlier action.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The perfect 'aangekom het' is the grammatical form after 'nadat' and keeps the same order of events; the sentence is not a protected wording.

toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by AWS 2017 and also marks the end of the 'nie' clause clearly; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Ons noem hierdie hulp na albei kante toe inter-afhanklikheid
toegepas.na: Hierdie hulp na albei kante toe noem ons inter-afhanklikheid
toegepas.rede_vinder: With 'noem' and 'na' together the sentence can be misread as 'name after'; fronting the object keeps the phrase together and reads more clearly.
toegepas.fout: The long object between 'noem' and the term makes the sentence stumble, and 'noem ... na' can briefly read as 'name after'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fronting the object keeps 'hulp na albei kante toe' together and puts the new term at the end, with the same meaning.

toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma sits before the protected wording and leaves 'baie plante het ook diere nodig' intact, including the qualifier 'baie'.

laat_vaar.blok: Baie plante het diere nodig vir hulle sade
laat_vaar.voor: los die sade in sy mis op 'n nuwe plek
laat_vaar.na: laat die sade in sy mis op 'n nuwe plek agter
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'los' in this sense is colloquial; 'agterlaat' is the standard, natural verb for leaving something behind somewhere.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'los' is plain, natural Afrikaans for a Grade 5 reader; 'laat ... agter' is a lateral and longer swap.

vlae.blok: Alles kom uit die eie habitat
vlae.teks: Alles kom uit die eie habitat
vlae.rede: Block heading: 'die eie habitat' is unidiomatic; 'sy eie habitat' would be natural. Not proposed as a change because it is a heading the script may not be able to apply.
